review_notes: The file has one theorem, with a 6-line proof. I read the supporting lemmas in GrothendieckGroup.lean (`forall_localEulerCharacteristic_eq_localCardNorm_iff`, `localEulerCharacteristicK0_of`, `localCardNormK0_of`) and `indK0_of_indFDRep`. The proof reduces to the K0 homomorphisms, uses `hom_ext_fdRep` to check on basis classes, and rewrites with the named simp lemmas. It finishes with `congrArg Additive.ofMul` applied to the hypothesis. This is already direct and each step is a named, meaningful lemma. The only candidate was the repeated `(Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 (NeZero.ne ℓ))` term. Factoring it out would be a matter of taste, because the statement needs it anyway. Collapsing the `simp only` and `exact` into `simpa` would hide which lemmas are used. I did not find a simplification that is clearly better without loss of readability.
